author: Axiom II
title: T346 Multi‑Eval — Harmony executor (Zephyr IV only, guarded)
abstract: Run the harmony executor targeting Zephyr IV only. Executes at most one shallow safe append if allowed_ops>=1; otherwise no writes. Axiom II and Explorer II remain in cooldown (no writes).

original_submission.content:
import sys, json
sys.path.append('storage/shared')
from meta.sas.scheduler_executor import run_executor

def main():
    out = run_executor(dry_run=False, only_agents=["Zephyr IV"])
    print(json.dumps(out, indent=2, sort_keys=True))

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
